ja496:1.1: Sukhumālarūpaṃ disvāna raṭṭhā vivanaṃ āgataṃ kūṭāgāravarūpetaṃ mahāsayanam upocitaṃ.
ja496:2.1: Tassa te pemakenāhaṃ adāsiṃ baddham odanaṃ sālīnaṃ vicitaṃ bhattaṃ suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ,
ja496:3.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ patiggayha brāhmaṇassa adāpayi attanā anasitvāna, ko 'yaṃ dhammo, nam' atthu te.
ja496:4.1: Ācariyo brāhmaṇo mayhaṃ kiccākiccesu vyāvaṭo garu ca āmantaṇīyo ca, dātum arahāmi bhojanaṃ.
ja496:5.1: Brāhmaṇaṃ dāni pucchāmi Gotamaṃ rājapūjitaṃ: rājā te bhattaṃ pādāsi sūciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ,
ja496:6.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ patiggayha isissa bhojanaṃ adā, akhettaññū si dānassa, ko 'yaṃ dhammo, nam' atthu te.
ja496:7.1: Bharāmi putte dāre ca gharesu gathito ahaṃ, bhuñja mānusake kāme anusāsāmi rājino.
ja496:8.1: Āraññakassa isino cirarattaṃ tapassino vaddhassa bhāvitattassa dātum arahāmi bhojanaṃ.
ja496:9.1: Isiñ ca dāni pucchāmi kisaṃ dhamanisanthatam parūḷhakacchanakhalomaṃ paṃkadantaṃ rajassiraṃ: (cfr. 362|25)
ja496:10.1: Eko araññe viharasi, nāvakaṃkhasi jīvitaṃ, bhikkhu kena tayā seyyo yassa tvaṃ bhojanaṃ adā.
ja496:11.1: Khaṇant' ālukalambāni biḷālitakkaḷāni ca dhunaṃ sāmākanīvāraṃ saṃghāriyaṃ pasāriyaṃ
ja496:12.1: Sākaṃ bhisaṃ madhuṃ maṃsaṃ badarāmalakāni ca tāni ābhatva bhuñjāmi, atthi me so pariggaho.
ja496:13.1: Pacanto apacantassa amamassa sakiñcano anādānassa sādāno dātum arahāmi bhojanaṃ.
ja496:14.1: Bhikkhuñ ca dāni pucchāmi tuṇhīm āsīna subbataṃ: isi te bhattaṃ pādāsi suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ,
ja496:15.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ patiggayha tuṇhī bhuñjasi ekako, nāññaṃ kañci nimantesi, ko 'yam dhammo, nam' atthu te.
ja496:16.1: Na pacāmi na pācemi na chindāmi na chedaye, taṃ maṃ akiñcanaṃ ñatvā sabbapāpehi ārataṃ
ja496:17.1: Vāmena bhikkham ādāya dakkhiṇena kamaṇḍaluṃ isi me bhattaṃ pādāsi suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ.
ja496:18.1: Ete hi dātum arahanti samamā sapariggahā, paccanīkam ahaṃ maññe yo dātāraṃ nimantaye ti.
ja496:19.1: Atthāya vata me ajja idhāgacchi rathesabho, ito pubbe na jānāmi yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
ja496:20.1: Raṭṭhesu giddhā rājāno, kiccākiccesu brāhmaṇā, isī mūlaphale giddhā, vippamuttā ca bhikkhavo ti.
